messages:
sam: Observability alert: batch upserts to embeddings are getting 429s for ~5m, throughput cratered. Root cause looks like the new optimizer fallback in 2.0.4. I built a hotfix `2.0.5-hotfix` that disables the fallback and pins backpressure thresholds. Change window ends in ~40m. Requesting expedited deploy. @oncall-sre @release-lead

oncall-sre: Need quick verification plan + rollback criteria. If we can auto-rollback on clear signals I can sign off.

rachel: Ping the image sha and the minimal smoke commands please. Also confirm no DB schema or index migration.

sam: Image: `redwood/emb:2.0.5-hotfix` sha=`def4567c`. No schema/index changes. Smoke: `curl -sf http://embeddings.internal/health` then `python infra/tests/smoke_hasher.py --qps 40 --duration 90`. I ran a short smoke against staging, looks stable.

release-lead: Ops-bot: expedited approval check. Need :thumbsup: from 2 leads within 15m. Note in PR: https://git.host/release/pull/987

ops-bot: Expedited deploy requested by sam. Please react with :thumbsup: from 2 engineering leads within 15 minutes to proceed.

chris: :thumbsup: (sgtm)

qa: Running the smoke now in canary env, will post quick numbers.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Received deploy start: `/deploy start --svc=embeddings --image=redwood/emb:2.0.5-hotfix --canary=10% --notes="hotfix disable optimizer fallback"`

deploy-bot: Canary deployed -> 12 pods (10% traffic). Metrics: errors 0.10% (baseline 0.09%), p95 +10ms. Link: https://deploy.metrics/canary/7135550000

qa: Canary smoke: health ok, sample traffic succeeded. Saw a tiny spike in 429s at t+30s but normalized.

oncall-sre: Auto-rollback policy: rollback if 429s > 0.5% for 2 consecutive minutes OR p95 increase > 300ms for 2 consecutive minutes. I'll monitor and give manual override window of 10m after canary.

release-lead: I'm giving provisional thumbs up assuming auto-rollback is in place. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Approval threshold met. Proceeding with canary promotion when you command, sam.

sam: Promote to 50% please.

deploy-bot: Promoting canary to 50%...

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. 50% on `redwood/emb:2.0.5-hotfix`. Metrics steady.

sam: If 5m hold, we'll promote to 100%.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 100% now per release-lead approval...

deploy-bot: Swap started: routing 100% to `redwood/emb:2.0.5-hotfix`.

deploy-bot: Alert: auto-rollback rule triggered (p95 latency > 300ms for 2m). Initiating rollback to `redwood/emb:2.0.4` and draining new pods.

chris: Seeing higher tail latencies on traces, looks like GC pauses on particular instance types. Good rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete 100 -> `redwood/emb:2.0.4`. System traffic restored. Rollback ticket: HOTFIX-7391.

oncall-sre: Observability post-rollback: error rates and p95 back to baseline. Good. We'll hold and investigate GC traces; sam please open an RCA ticket and include heap profiles.

sam: Opening ticket now: https://tickets.host/TICKET-3910 1 will collect heap dumps and GC logs.

release-lead: Thanks team. Closing expedited window. Next steps: revert optimizer change from 2.0.4 branch and create targeted fix for GC interaction. Postmortem requested if this recurs.

qa: Leaving the canary pods pinned for debugging for 1 hour.

ops-bot: Expedited deploy closed by release-lead. Reminder: include changelog and rollback notes in final PR.

chris: Nice coordination, quick rollback worked as intended :white_check_mark:
